errors.text_span: На графиката са представени две линии: едната показва B2C пазарът в триллиони долари (синя)
errors.evidence: The description refers to the blue data series as a "line" when it is visually represented as a filled area chart. While the upper boundary is a line, calling it an area chart would be more accurate.

errors.text_span: Оранжевата линия започва от 2017 г. с показател 28%
errors.evidence: The orange line representing growth does not have a value for 2017. The first value shown, 28%, is positioned above the year 2018 on the x-axis.

The description incorrectly claims the growth rate (orange line) shows a consistent decrease. The values fluctuate, for example, increasing from 17% in 2020 to 18% in 2021, and from 13% in 2022 to 16% in 2023.

errors.text_span: Стойностите на ръста са съответно 28% през 2017 г., 26% през 2018 г., 17% през 2019 г., 18% през 2020 г., 13% през 2021 г.
errors.evidence: The entire list of growth percentages is incorrectly mapped to the years, with a consistent one-year shift. For example, the chart shows 28% growth for 2018, not 2017; 26% for 2019, not 2018, and so on.
The chart shows a growth rate of 13% for the year 2022, not 16%. The value of 16% corresponds only to the year 2023.
